## Description

Tenant level: owner accepts Medvya Terms of Service and the clinic Data Processing Agreement during onboarding; the clinic privacy notice is published (versioned). Patient level (Consents step): treatment (required, locked), reminders on WhatsApp/SMS (per channel), link to ABHA (India) / HIE (UAE, per emirate), portal access (invite in P4), health tips & offers (off by default). Each decision stores CONSENT_RECEIPT with consent_type, policy_version, jurisdiction, decision, decided_at, channel and actor. Recording consent is NOT asked here (per-visit, P3).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every consent is a separate toggle; marketing defaults off; treatment is required and cannot be toggled off.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each decision creates an immutable receipt (ledger) with policy version and jurisdiction; changing a decision creates a new receipt and keeps history.
- [ ] **AC3.** The privacy notice version shown at registration is the currently published one; publishing a new version does not alter old receipts.
- [ ] **AC4.** Owners cannot activate the production tenant until ToS and DPA acceptance is recorded.
- [ ] **AC5.** Reminder sending (MDV-P1-032/033) checks the channel consent before every send (test).
- [ ] **AC6.** Final wording is the legally reviewed text from MDV-P1-044 in en/hi/ar.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
